listing.name: Kirby 64 Recompiled
listing.summary: Explore Kirby 64 Recompiled and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Prepare upstream or keep an existing game build
steps.instruction: This project is under construction and has no published player downloads at the reviewed cutoff. Follow its recursive clone and make instructions; the documented native output is build/Kirby64Recompiled and your own supported NK4E.z64 must be in its launch working directory. Keep the selected toolchain and original-file requirements from upstream. Register only a prepared native game output, not the compiler tools.

steps.title: Keep your files and update through upstream
steps.instruction: Keep the game in a separate folder you control, and retain a working copy. Review its executable in Portcove, then add it without changing its files. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external copy. Follow the project’s instructions for the version you use when changing it.
